title: TAT-3530 Display limit orders on the chart
description: Place a resting testnet limit order, open the market chart, and prove the Limit overlay is on the visible chart.

proofTargets.claim: A resting limit order is drawn on the market chart.

ensure-session.intent: Unlock the fixture wallet and confirm Perps session

reset-orders.intent: Drop leftover testnet orders so the next Limit is a fresh on-scale placement

ensure-limit-order.intent: Place a resting BTC long Limit 1% below mid so the Limit line sits in the 15m frame

assert-order-state.intent: Prove controller has an open BTC order before chart proof

open-market.intent: Open BTC market details so the chart overlay can render

wait-market-details.intent: Confirm the BTC Pro market screen is in the viewport

expand-chart.intent: Use the already-expanded BTC chart when persist left it open

scroll-chart-into-view.intent: Keep the BTC chart above the order ticket in the visible frame

wait-chart-panel.intent: Confirm the BTC chart panel is on screen before capture

wait-chart-content.intent: Confirm the BTC chart body is mounted before capture

capture-chart.label: AC1: Limit order line visible on the BTC chart
capture-chart.intent: Keep a still of the BTC chart with the resting Limit price line in view

cleanup-orders.intent: Remove the temporary BTC testnet limit order
